string.name: faq_howto_body
string.value: Get a working configuration (see below), import it (via the import icon or from an attachment in an email), select the profile in the list and connect by tapping the name of the profile. If the connection does not work the log window may help to find the problem.

string.name: faq_killswitch_body
string.value: Using the persist-tun option will keep the tunnel open but there may be situations where the OS drops the tunnel. The only reliable method to block non-VPN traffic is to use the system setting 'Block connections without VPN' together with Always-On VPN.

string.name: faq_remote_api_body
string.value: The app can be controlled remotely via APIs. Third party apps can start and stop VPN connections and import profiles if the user grants access.

string.name: faq_ncp_title
string.value: Failed to negotiate cipher with server

string.name: faq_ncp_body
string.value: Newer client versions disable old ciphers like BF-CBC by default. If your server only supports these old ciphers, enable the OpenSSL legacy provider or set an appropriate compatibility mode in the profile settings.

string.name: faq_md5_body
string.value: Newer OpenSSL versions refuse certificates signed with weak hashes (e.g. MD5). The preferred solution is to regenerate the certificates. As a workaround the TLS security profile can be set to insecure in the Authentication/Encryption settings.

string.name: faq_duplicate_notifications_body
string.value: The VPN runs as a foreground service and therefore has to show a notification. This notification is not an app notification and cannot be fully disabled. The key icon shown by the system is also not from this app.

string.name: faq_different_clients_body
string.value: OpenVPN for Android (this app, open source, uses OpenVPN 2.x, aimed at advanced users), OpenVPN Connect (official client using the OpenVPN 3 C++ core) and older root-based solutions differ in features and behaviour.

string.name: faq_battery_body
string.value: The keepalive of the VPN (e.g. keepalive 10 60) forces the mobile radio to stay active which is the main battery drain. This cannot be changed by the client. UDP keepalives longer than 60 s may be dropped by NAT routers. Also avoid TCP-over-TCP setups which perform poorly.

string.name: faq_tap_body
string.value: tap device support is not possible without root and is therefore not supported by this app. Use tun mode.

string.name: faq_copying_log_body
string.value: Long press a single log entry to copy it to the clipboard. Use Send/Copy log to copy the whole log.

string.name: faq_routing_body
string.value: The app uses the system VPN interface API instead of ifconfig/route. There is no gateway concept; excluded routes are implemented via negative routes. The system uses policy routing which can be inspected with 'ip rule'.

string.name: faq_non_cidr_body
string.value: The system only supports CIDR routes. Non CIDR netmask routes are replaced by /32 host routes and a warning is issued.

string.name: faq_proxy_body
string.value: If no DNS servers are set the system may still use the system proxy for connections over the VPN. If DNS servers are set, no proxy is used. There is no proxy API for VPNs.

string.name: faq_security_body
string.value: Data on the shared storage is not secure. Delete the original certificate/key files after importing them into the app. Consider importing PKCS12 files into the system keystore.

string.name: faq_shortcut_body
string.value: You can place a shortcut on the home screen to quickly connect the default VPN.
